sources.title: Democratizing access to large-scale language models with OPT-175B
sources.evidence: Dated May 3, 2022; explicitly announces full release of smaller OPT baselines including 6.7 billion parameters, and states that all pretrained models use the OPT license.

sources.title: OPT: Open Pre-trained Transformer Language Models
sources.evidence: The original developer report describes decoder-only text language models. Table 1 gives the 6.7B variant 32 layers, 32 attention heads and width 4096; section 2.2 specifies ReLU and sequence length 2048. It supplies a rounded 6.7B label, not a separate active-parameter count. Reopened October 27, 2026: Table 1 still identifies the 6.7B variant; no separate active count is stated.

sources.title: Official OPT pretrained model weights
sources.evidence: Lists OPT-6.7B as 6.7B with a public checkpoint link and applies the model license. Current link is the v1_20230405 repackaged checkpoint; that path is not the original release date. Fresh HTTPS retrieval on October 27, 2026 again confirms the explicit 6.7B Parameters column.

sources.title: OPT-175B License Agreement
sources.evidence: The model-weight license permits reproduction, distribution and derivative works solely for non-commercial research. It is distinct from the metaseq code license.

sources.title: OPT-6.7B pinned configuration
sources.evidence: Fetched over HTTPS at revision a45aa65bbeb77c1558bc99bedc6779195462dab0: OPTForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden and embedding width 4096, FFN width 16384, 32 heads, vocabulary 50272, 2048 positions, pre-layer normalization, final normalization retained, and float16. No quantization configuration. Reopened the same pinned configuration on October 27, 2026.

sources.title: OPT-6.7B pinned PyTorch checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Fetched as JSON over HTTPS after the web renderer failed. All 516 weight-map names exactly match the configuration-derived learned tensors: 16 per layer plus token/position embeddings and final norm weight/bias. No independent LM head, buffer or quantization metadata keys. total_size is 13,316,947,968 bytes, matching twice the derived parameter count. No weight shards were downloaded or unpickled. Reopened the same pinned index on October 27, 2026; retained the prior reconciliation without a new tensor census or shard download.

sources.title: Transformers 4.21.0 OPT implementation
sources.evidence: Defines biased Q/K/V/output and FFN linears, affine layer norms, learned position embeddings with two extra rows, and tied token/LM-head weights. Equal embedding and hidden widths omit projection layers; configuration retains the final norm. These definitions explain every indexed tensor.

sources.title: Official OPT-6.7B repository metadata
sources.evidence: Fetched as JSON over HTTPS: main revision a45aa65bbeb77c1558bc99bedc6779195462dab0, repository created May 11, 2022, last modified January 24, 2023. Contains two PyTorch .bin shards and their index, with no safetensors files. Repository creation is later than the original Meta release.

sources.title: From Compression to Specialization: An Information-Preserving Approach for Dense to Mixture-of-Experts Construction — Table 8
sources.publisher: MIDAS research authors / OpenReview, ICLR 2026 submission
sources.evidence: October 27, 2026: read the original paper’s search-indexed Table 8 caption, headers and rows. OPT-6.7B (Zhang et al., 2022a) is a dense baseline: non-embedding activated 6.44B, activated 6.66B, total 6.66B. This is the MIDAS authors’ comparison convention. Direct PDF/forum/hash requests and browser access hit OpenReview verification; the full PDF was not downloaded or visually inspected.

name.note: Matches the official OPT-6.7B variant; spacing is a catalog display convention.

developer.note: Released and developed by Meta AI.

family.note: Member of the Open Pre-trained Transformers family.

release_date.note: Original public model release is explicitly dated May 3, 2022 and includes 6.7B; May 11 is the later Hugging Face repository creation. The May 2 paper submission is not the release date.

open_weights.note: Public pretrained checkpoint distribution is confirmed; open_weights does not imply an unrestricted license.

license.note: Descriptive baseline label accurately summarizes the model license applied to OPT-6.7B.

parameters_b.note: Configuration-derived complete learned-parameter count for pinned HF revision a45aa65bbeb77c1558bc99bedc6779195462dab0: 32*(4*4096^2 + 2*4096*16384 + 9*4096 + 16384) + 50272*4096 + (2048+2)*4096 + 2*4096 = 6,658,473,984. Includes all linear biases, two affine norms per block and final norm. The 50272x4096 token matrix is counted once because the bias-free LM head is tied; equal widths need no input/output projection. All 516 expected tensor names match the index and FP16 byte total. This is metadata/configuration reconciliation, not direct weight-header inspection. The developer label 6.7B is rounded; no buffers, packed storage or quantization scales enter the sum. October 27 re-audit retains this previously established precise total after reopening the original report, official nominal-size table and pinned configuration/index; no new tensor census was performed.

active_parameters_b.note: Table 8 explicitly reports 6.66B activated for the unchanged OPT-6.7B dense baseline, distinct from its 6.44B non-embedding column. Retain the research authors’ two-decimal nominal convention, which agrees with the precise total at that precision. This is not a Meta active-count disclosure or an exact per-token participation claim. The complete table text was retrieved through the search index; direct PDF access remained challenged.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer with 32 standard attention/FFN blocks; the exact configuration and implementation contain no expert routing.

context_window.note: The report specifies training sequence length 2048 and the exact configuration sets max_position_embeddings=2048; the two extra learned position rows are an offset, not extra context.

modalities.note: Autoregressive text language model with token inputs and vocabulary logits; no image, audio or video components.

reasoning.note: The checked primary documentation does not define a native reasoning mode for this pretrained checkpoint. General language-task performance does not establish this flag, and absence of documentation does not establish false.

tool_call.note: Native structured tool calling is not specified for this base checkpoint in the checked primary sources. No false claim is inferred from that omission.

description.note: The concise baseline accurately describes this pretrained research release without unsupported capability claims.

patch.notes: OPT-6.7B is Meta’s nominal size label; the pinned official checkpoint reconciles to 6.658473984B learned parameters, counting tied embeddings once. MIDAS Table 8 reports 6.66B activated under its research comparison convention, including embeddings; this is rounded and is not a separate Meta disclosure. Public research weights use non-commercial terms.

sources.label: MIDAS original comparison: OPT-6.7B activated parameters, Table 8

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains the previously reconciled total of 6.658473984B and adds nominal active parameters of 6.66B from MIDAS Table 8. The original table text was search-index accessible; full PDF access was challenged. All 12 unrelated assessments are preserved. No weight shards or new tensor census.
